_source: Angel.vb. Screen units, per frame; flapRate and hurtDelay are seconds. rectWidth and rectBottom are the angel's hit rectangle (X..X+0.06 by Y+0.03..Y+angelSize/2), used by the heart. boundsX and boundsY are checkBounds' clamp on X and Y (left -0.6, right 0.5, bottom -0.6, top 0.4). angelOffset is where the angelSize quad is drawn from X, Y (renderAngel's matAngel translation, the hover added to its y); linkOffsetX is where the hand (Chain.vb's link 0) hangs from X, facing right then left (renderAngel's linkOffset.X 0 and 0.033); it hangs at Y plus the hover.

port._about: Not in the original; world units, never mapped. contactShape Rectangle (the default, U.CHN-T88) tests Angel.vb's rectangle (rectWidth, rectBottom and angelSize above, from X, Y) against Enemy.vb's with Root.vb's rectIntersect (only the angel's edges inside the enemy's); Circle is the port's earlier contactRadius circle, a data option only. arenaBounds false (the default, U.CHN-T86) clamps the angel to checkBounds' boundsX/boundsY; true is the port's earlier choice, the level's arena inset by boundsMargin, kept only as a data option.
